summary: Recent discussions focus on extending Parquet’s schema to support fixed‑size numeric vectors and refining its versioning strategy. One thread proposes adding MIN_LENGTH and MAX_LENGTH metadata to encode VECTOR(N) constraints, while another outlines a two‑tier format change model—add‑everywhere and compatibility level—to accelerate feature rollout and maintain reader correctness.

highlights.text: Adding MIN_LENGTH and MAX_LENGTH metadata fields to represent fixed‑size numeric vectors in Parquet.
